quote_candidates.text: “The article as we know it is gone.” — Gard Steiro, Editor-in-Chief at Norway’s VG
“I think it is an incredible time to be in News and journalism and the public are seeking out trustworthy news and information.” — Justin Stevens, Director of News, ABC, Australia
Publishers expect traffic from search engines to decline by more than 40% over the next three years – not quite ‘Google Zero’ but a substantial impact none the less.
The fear is that human-generated, verified content will soon be drowned out by machine-made ‘AI slop’.
It’s a delicate balancing act but one that – if they can pull it off – holds out the promise of greater efficiency and more relevant and engaging journalism.
